name: The nut butter trio
tagline: Almond, cashew and pistachio butter in three small jars.
metaDescription: A gift set of three small jars: creamy almond butter, mellow cashew butter and vivid pistachio butter. Spread, stir or eat by the spoon.
description: Three small jars, three very different spreads. Almond butter is toasty and a touch sweet, cashew butter is soft and mellow, and pistachio butter is rich, savoury and unmistakably green. Together they make an easy tasting set.

Each jar is made with nuts and nothing much else, so the flavour is clean and the texture is naturally smooth. A little oil may rise to the top, which is normal and shows there are no stabilisers. Stir it back in and you are ready to go.

Spread them on toast, swirl them into porridge, or whisk a spoonful into a dressing or a sauce. Pistachio butter on warm bread with a pinch of salt is a small joy. Cashew butter turns a smoothie creamy without any fuss.
The jars are small enough to finish in a week or two, so everything stays fresh. Our homemade nut butter post is a good read for anyone who wants to try making a batch themselves.
ingredients: See the contents list on the product page.
mayContain: May contain traces of other tree nuts and peanuts.
storage: Store unopened in a cool, dry cupboard. After opening, keep in the fridge and stir before use.
